title: Docking compression
load_definition: 25 kN total -X at forward docking ring
boundary_condition: Aft-end octagonal frame fixed for ground-test correlation
primary_outputs: Global axial load path; dock-frame stress

title: Electric-propulsion thrust
load_definition: 12 kN total +X distributed over six propulsion mounts
boundary_condition: Aft-end frame fixed for screening; flight inertia relief required later

title: Twin-ring centrifugal
load_definition: 2,433.19 N radial at each of 24 ring outer nodes
boundary_condition: Aft-end fixed screening; repeat with minimum stabilisation/inertia relief

title: Single-sector imbalance
load_definition: 500 kg equivalent imbalance at one Ring 1 outer node

title: Emergency ring braking
load_definition: 6.484 kN·m braking torque applied tangentially to each ring
primary_outputs: Tangential ring stiffness and hub torque path

title: Misaligned docking
load_definition: 25 kN axial plus 2.5 kN lateral docking load
primary_outputs: Forward bending, dock alignment and truss stiffness

title: Free-free flight modes
boundary_condition: No supports; six rigid-body modes expected

title: Joint-stiffness sensitivity
load_definition: Repeat critical cases with 0.25×, 0.5×, 1× and rigid joint stiffness

title: Mass-location sensitivity
load_definition: Shift major remote masses ±0.5 m along X

title: Imperfection sensitivity
load_definition: Apply first buckling mode as 0.1%, 0.5% and 1% member-length imperfection
